app_store.name: RajnishGem

app_store.promotional_text: A chat shell, a terminal shell and creator links in a small Android app.
app_store.description: RajnishGem is a small Android workspace with a chat screen, a terminal-style screen and an About panel with creator links. It is written from scratch as a clean-room project and does not include an agent runtime or a real shell.
